# The outcome of `iunctus run <workflow> -executor simulator -profile test -stub-run -max-pending 8
# -order shuffled:1` with the simulator for every Nextflow workflow of WorkflowHub of
# the test workflows (without `-profile test` for a workflow without that profile): `ok` (with
# a valid execution graph), or the exit code and the first line of the error (33 for
# unsupported features). run_evidence.txt says why each workflow that fails cannot run.
# Recorded offline with one workflow at a time in a network-isolated namespace.
# Remote inputs and metadata absent from the local cache are unavailable.
